profile.headline: Software Engineer - React | JavaScript/TypeScript | Python - Former Telepresence Robotics Startup Founder
profile.summary:
I previously worked as co-founder and CEO of my own startup, Shortcut Robotics. At Shortcut, we 
produced video call (telepresence) robots that users could call into and then control remotely. During my time at Shortcut (3.5 years), I picked up many software and technical skills. By the end, I had designed and printed 3D parts, written code in 6 different languages and was able to fully construct a robot from just raw materials. I sampled many job functions as an early-stage startup founder, but over time I realized I was gravitating more and more toward the coding side of the business. I found coding to be very rewarding while allowing me to utilize my creativity and problem-solving skills.

Ultimately, I realized I wanted to continue pursuing software engineering and decided a software bootcamp (App Academy) was the right next step. During the bootcamp, I rounded out the knowledge base that I built up at Shortcut. I also gained heightened proficiency in various languages like JavaScript and Python, as well as various technologies like React, Redux, Flask, Websockets, and AWS. I've worked on several projects, of which I’m most proud of a clone of the website Trello, in which I implemented Atlassian’s drag and drop library for seamless task organization. Today, I’m looking forward to continuing my software engineering journey.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer and Founding Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed entire full stack website and software for robot webRTC video call platform (built with JavaScript, Python, PHP, CSS, HTML, SQL, Arduino) with 50% less latency than other video call platforms like Zoom
• Employed AWS (M2 instances, Kinesis) to host backend SQL database and Apache server to maximize security/scalability
• Utilized 3D printing and CAD software to design and build a fully-functional, 6’6” human-height video call robot, including design iteration through beta testing phase
• Managed many other aspects of the business, including fundraising, investor communications, regulatory compliance, part sourcing, shipping logistics, marketing, conference showcasing and budgeting
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Front-End Development · 3D Printing · Sales · Mechanical Engineering · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Market Research · 3D Prototyping · Fundraising · Back-End Web Development · Git · Webrtc · Linux

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Designed a comprehensive innovation process for a $1B financial services company in a rapidly evolving market
• Conducted interviews with leading innovation company experts to inform a set of innovation process best practices
• Facilitated workshop with top executives (e.g., CEO, CFO, etc.) to propose recommendations and drive consensus
• Created several templates / models to assess and prioritize innovation ideas; client has used these templates to evaluate over 15 new initiatives

Performed diligence on a potential mortgage servicing investment for a private equity firm with over $100B AUM
• Analyzed third party data to inform market size projections and key headwinds and tailwinds impacting the market
• Conducted two site visits to diligence target to assess opportunities for operational improvement
• Collaborated on a financial model to understand how the platform’s annual margins on purchased loans had evolved

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Underwrote properties, created cost and income projections, drafted investor presentations, drafted letters of intent, contacted and met with brokers, analyzed market trends, generated property comparables. Used Excel, CoStar and Argus Enterprise extensively.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Researched housing markets and constructed investment brochures. Conducted financial analyses using Microsoft Excel.
